_comment: Where completed work gets announced. Read by merge-request (code) and the founder-ops skills. Add a channel HERE, never inline a raw channel ID in a SKILL.md.

transport.note: Posts go through the Slack connector's own tool, as the founder's own user. There is no bot token and no webhook in this repo — do not add one. Resolve the actual tool name at runtime rather than trusting a name written here; connector tool names change and a stale name fails silently at 3am.
transport.if_unavailable: Skip the post, say so in the run report, and fall back to PushNotification. A missing connector is never a reason to fail a chain that otherwise passed.

code-changes.name: #code-changes
code-changes.when: An MR is open AND its head pipeline has passed — i.e. a reviewable artifact exists and the human is the only thing left.
code-changes.never: Do not post on a failed or still-running pipeline, on a Draft MR, or on an escalation. Those are PushNotification's job. This channel means 'ready to review'; if it also carries 'something broke', it stops meaning anything.
code-changes.why: The founder walks away mid-chain. This is the ping that says the walk-away worked, so an unattended run ends in a place they actually look rather than a terminal nobody reopens.

general.name: #general
general.when: A founder-ops skill finishes a deliverable — a plan, a content pack, a pipeline review, a weekly command centre.
general.never: Never post the deliverable's contents if it contains customer names, pricing, or anything drafted for an external recipient. Announce that it is ready and where it is; the founder opens it.
general.why: FYI only. Drafts stay drafts — this announces that something is ready to look at, it does not send anything to a customer or prospect.
